name: Moravia
source:
"You still don't know anything, do you?"

A mysterious girl who shows up in Theta leading a horde of Vectors, with Hyuga and Yukinami in tow.

Something about her seems other-wordly...

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
